english: GMet expects the rains to start from the {onset_start} to the {onset_end}.
dagaare: GMet tɛgɛɛ la ka saa na piili la {onset_start} gaa tɔ {onset_end}.

english: GMet expects the rains to start from the {onset_start} to the {onset_end}, later than usual.
dagaare: GMet tɛgɛɛ la ka saa na piili la {onset_start} gaa tɔ {onset_end}, e ŋmaa gaŋ lɛ naŋ maŋ e.

english: GMet expects the rains to start from the {onset_start} to the {onset_end}, earlier than usual.
dagaare: GMet tɛgɛɛ la ka saa na piili la {onset_start} gaa tɔ {onset_end}, pɔge gaŋ lɛ naŋ maŋ e.

english: A dry spell of {dry_days} days may follow, so do not plant on the first rains.
dagaare: Wuloo/yooroo naŋ e {dry_days} bebiri na baŋ tu la, ka fo da kɔɔ a saa dɛŋdɛŋ.

english: Rains should end from the {cess_start} to the {cess_end}.
dagaare: Saa na baare la {cess_start} gaa tɔ {cess_end}.

english: Wait for steady rains before sowing.
dagaare: Guuli ka saa sigi velaa ka fo wa kɔɔ.
Bɔɔ fo karema/wuliraa naŋ kaa toma.
